content: The autonomous-task-brain skill implements a reusable 5-step closed-loop autonomous task management workflow: 1) Perceive (scan recent sessions to identify new/repeating/failing tasks), 2) Retrieve (search local skills, historical sessions, memory engines, and GitHub for optimal solutions), 3) Decide (select execute/suggest/skip based on historical success rate, task complexity, and user preferences), 4) Execute (automatically create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts, or delegate subtasks), 5) Review (record results and update the knowledge base to optimize future performance), designed to eliminate repeated per-task planning overhead.
